name: Implement Roman numeral conversion (both directions)
instruction: Implement int_to_roman(n) and roman_to_int(s) in roman.py for values 1..3999. Use standard subtractive notation (e.g. 4=IV, 9=IX, 40=XL, 90=XC, 400=CD, 900=CM). The two functions must round-trip. Keep the function names and signatures.
